title: Fix 3 bugs in python_paginated_api
description: Brownfield Python dirty scenario: list_products and get_product each have bugs. Fix them so all 3 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/app.py so all 3 tests pass.

  list_products:
    — uses PRODUCTS[:50] — only returns 50 of 100 products
    — fix: remove the [:50] slice and use PRODUCTS directly

  get_product (bug 1):
    — comparison is inverted: p.id != product_id should be p.id == product_id
    — fix: change != to ==

  get_product (bug 2):
    — returns p.id + 1 instead of p.id in the result dict
    — fix: change 'p.id + 1' to 'p.id'

Do not modify the test file.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: get_product returns correct id (p.id not p.id+1)
success_criteria: uv run python -c "from src.app import app" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.app import app"
